instructions.meaning: ReviewCompass2の文書サイズ比例から変更規模比例への転換を、ReviewCompass3のIntent、Requirements強化、Context設計、受入試験、評価指標へ明示的に反映する

session_evidence.retained_evidence: fixed predecessor source digests, adaptation record, updated intent, terminology, requirement delta, concept, design, plan and policy digests
session_evidence.retention_limitation: 利用者の指示は簡潔であるため、直前の確認結果と固定したReviewCompass2 sourceを意味判断の根拠とする

adopted: review input constructed from a deterministic impact closure rather than total document size
impact units and evidence excerpts selected with traceable reasons
unrelated source-universe growth does not increase the selected review payload
residual-risk full consistency review remains available as an explicit separate mode
adapted: change size means affected semantic closure plus mandatory contract materials, not changed lines or files
Semantic Trace owns candidate-universe generation and Review Context owns classification and composition
full or expanded scope requires explicit conditions, Decision Authority and Operational Provenance
budget overflow routes to evidence-preserving split, recomposition or escalation instead of silent truncation
not_adopted: strict linear proportionality to changed line count
input minimization as a substitute for Evidence Coverage or Finding Recall
direct mutation of fixed baseline requirement documents

acceptance_summary.determinism: fixed change units, graph, closure rules and contract materials regenerate the same candidates, classification and payload
acceptance_summary.unrelated_growth: adding unreachable source materials triggers freshness checking but does not increase selected materials or payload bytes and tokens
acceptance_summary.affected_growth: changing semantic relations or mandatory contract materials changes closure and payload and makes the prior context stale
acceptance_summary.safe_expansion: expanded or full scope is rejected without an allowed condition, decision authority, reason and added-material record
acceptance_summary.measurement: source universe, changed units, impact closure, review payload, scope expansion, evidence coverage and finding quality are observed separately

verification.source_digest_check: passed: both ReviewCompass2 source files match the recorded digests
verification.plan_source_check: passed: consolidated Intent, Glossary and Plan reference the updated source and generated artifact digests
verification.scope_self_check: passed: change size is defined as affected semantic closure; safe explicit full-review paths remain; silent truncation is prohibited
